intro: Herbal teas for periodontal disease are natural remedies that combine the healing properties of herbs with the soothing benefits of tea to treat and prevent the progression of this oral health condition. Additionally, other herbal teas such as echinacea tea, which boosts the immune system, and licorice root tea, which has anti-inflammatory properties, have also been used to treat periodontal disease due to their ability to reduce inflammation and promote gum healing.
